# Security Allow-List
# ==================
# Pattern ported from codebase-memory-mcp (scripts/security-allowlist.txt).
#
# Format: filepath:function:justification
# Every "dangerous" call in the codebase must appear here with a
# justification, OR the security scan will flag it.
#
# This replaces hardcoded exceptions in security_scan.py and serves
# as auditable documentation of every risky call site.

# ── Subprocess execution ──────────────────────────────────────
tools/deploy.py:_run_command:git init/scaffold/deploy operations are the intended purpose of the deploy tool
tools/deploy.py:subprocess.run:scaffold mode runs git init, git add, git commit to bootstrap new projects
tools/generate_harness.py:subprocess.run:runs ruff format and ruff check via subprocess after file generation

# ── Environment variable access ───────────────────────────────
tools/harness_config.py:os.environ:config loader reads SOLOCODE_* env vars for config override layer
tools/solocode_config.py:os.environ:reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and model env vars for AI model launcher

# ── File system operations on command-line paths ──────────────
tools/deploy.py:shutil.copy2:core function of deploy.py — copying harness files to target project
tools/deploy.py:shutil.copytree:recursive directory copy for harness scaffold
tools/generate_harness.py:shutil.copy2:generates .opencode/ artifacts from .kilo/ templates

# ── Shell command execution for verification ──────────────────
.github/scripts/checklist.py:subprocess.run:orchestrates ruff check, pytest, node test suites — all harness tools
.github/scripts/eval_harness.py:subprocess.run:runs harness evaluation tests in subprocess for isolation
